prediction_rule: Original saved per-seed threshold (strict probability > threshold); five-seed majority (>=3), matching cross-market statistics; no reselection
execution: Close-only: signal at t, execute at next frozen observed close t+1, earn price return from t+1 to t+2 onward. Same signal-date close execution forbidden. Fees charged at execution-date close.
accounting: net_return_t = position_at_previous_close * close_to_close_return_t - per_side_fee * abs(position_at_close - previous_position). Final liquidation fee at last close.
evaluation: Per-market common window: first saved prediction date + one observed date through last frozen 2025 observation. Start flat before first execution; no 2026 rows. All benchmarks use identical dates.
daily_tail: Last available signal held through evaluation end; tail dates flagged as stale. No new predictions fabricated.
nonoverlap: Schedule signals every 20 frozen raw observation dates starting at first prediction; execute next close; hold at most 20 observed intervals, then next scheduled signal or cash if absent. No favorable schedule phase selection.
per_side: Half round-trip cost, charged per unit one-way turnover; index tracking ETF/future stylized fee, not index tradability
return_basis: Frozen Close price returns in local index currency; no dividends, FX conversion, financing, taxes, tracking error or explicit slippage beyond fixed stylized costs
trades: Number of one-way entries/exits; round trips separately; average holding period in observed close intervals
hit_rate: Fraction positive net daily returns among days with previous-close equity exposure >0; not forecast accuracy

bootstrap.method: paired noncircular moving date-block bootstrap of realized primary daily net returns; no extra trades invented at block joins
bootstrap.CI: 95% percentile, exploratory; no formal multiple-comparison significance claim

regime: Use saved causal HMM label on realized return date, no HMM refit, no regime-conditioned signal changes; conditional annualized return is geometric mean over regime dates raised to252, not contiguous-regime CAGR
